title: Meow footer
description: A tall ink-dark footer: four columns of small links under bold group names (two-column lists on phones), a row with the orange-icon wordmark and the copyright line, a full-width hairline, then long paragraphs of disclosures in comfortable 16/24 white text with underlined links.
notes: always dark: it carries the theme's dark tokens (class `dark`) in both modes
`legal` takes any number of paragraphs; bold and italic inside are kept
